en: Sepia postcard view of a leafy park scene with many people in early 20th‑century attire sitting on benches and strolling. A decorative bandshell/bandstand stands in the background. Caption on the front reads "Bad Pyrmont – Konzertplatz." The reverse has German handwriting in purple ink, a green Deutsches Reich stamp, and a circular postmark from Pyrmont dated 4.9.13, addressed to a woman in the Celle area.
